mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with tretinoin increases risk of intracranial hypertension and potential serotonergic effects; tretinoin is known to cause pseudotumor cerebri which may be potentiated by MAOI use.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if essential, monitor closely for signs of increased intracranial pressure (headache, vision changes, papilledema) and consider alternative acne treatments.
